faq.title: FAQ's
faq.description: Find answers to all your questions about hiring trusted helpers, offering your services, and navigating our DESI community platform with ease and confidence.
faq.a1: DesiHelpers.com is a community platform that connects Indian families in the U.S. with trusted helpers and service providers—like nannies, caterers, bakers, and tutors—who understand their cultural needs. It makes finding and offering services easy, reliable, and feel like family, all in one place.
faq.q2: 2. How does the platform help Job Posters?
faq.a2: Job posters can easily list their requirements and connect with verified service providers in their local area who match their specific cultural and service needs.
faq.q3: 3. How does DesiHelpers.com help job seekers?
faq.a3: Job seekers can create profiles showcasing their skills and connect directly with families looking for their specific services, helping them find meaningful work.
faq.q4: 4. Is the platform free to use?
faq.a4: Yes, joining the community and browsing listings is completely free for everyone.
faq.q5: 5. Does the platform collect any sensitive information?
faq.a5: No, we prioritize user privacy. We do not collect sensitive personal data beyond what is necessary for connecting trusted members.

about.hero_title: Connecting Communities, One Helper at a Time
about.hero_subtitle: We make finding trusted household help simple, fast, and free—while building a supportive community where people help people.
about.problem_body_1: The way people search for household help—nannies, chefs, tutors, and more—has changed drastically. Most rely on multiple social media groups, messaging apps, or word-of-mouth to post their needs or services.
about.problem_body_2: Our platform provides a one-stop, scalable solution for all helper needs:
about.check_1: Posters can view active profiles nearby and connect instantly—no posting or reposting required.
about.check_2: Seekers can see verified opportunities in their area—without endless group hopping.
about.summary: This means faster connections, less effort, and a better experience for everyone.
about.mission_subtitle: Our mission is simple - to create value by assisting you in finding high quality leads for your household needs saving your time and frustration from other platforms and connections.
about.mission_connect_desc: Connect and engage with potential social contacts on our platform
about.mission_care_desc: Find the nanny or household Care and support your need to elevate your lifestyle
about.mission_excel_desc: Foster the community culture and Excel together
about.testimonials_heading: What Our Members Have To Say
about.testimonial_quote: DesiHelpers.com has saved me so much time in searching for ethnic help. I have deleted all the community Whatsapp groups now.
